data.rationale: The proposal matches the true hotel-search flow (destination with suggestion, dates, rooms/guests, search, then sort/filter) with parameters that largely cover the true ones, but it adds children and child-age details that weren't in the actual run, and it files the rooms/guests step before search where the true run did it after. It is concrete enough to automate, though the filter and sort inputs are described loosely.
